Describe acoustic tracking and its requirement for a clear line of sight.
Identify the main categories of optical sensors used in vision-based tracking.

Describe model-based tracking, specifically focusing on SLAM and PTAM techniques.
Explain 3D structure tracking using depth sensors and 3D models.

Describe alternative tracking sensors like GPS and their specific use cases and limitations.
Explain motion capture and eye-tracking systems.
Define hybrid trackers and explain their performance advantages over single-technology systems.
Summarize the tracking technologies covered and preview the next topic.
